xmz4f9ny.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 110 cm Wide - White - 210 cm
xmz4f9ny.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree is a centerpiece of any holiday display, bringing festive cheer with its modern, minimalistic aesthetic. Its sleek cone shape is adorned with dynamic LED lights that transform any space into a winter wonderland, whether it's placed in the living room or an outdoor terrace. Built for convenience, this tree adds style to seasonal decor while being perfect for family gatherings. Its ease of assembly ensures that you'll spend less time setting up and more time celebrating. Materials: Constructed from PVC and steel, this tree is both abrasion-resistant and sturdy, ensuring it withstands the joys of Christmas year after year. The choice of materials results in a polished appearance that seamlessly blends durability with elegance, making it not only a practical choice but also an aesthetically pleasing addition to any holiday setup. Included Components: This package comes with an LED string light featuring 8 different flash modes that add a flicker of excitement to any occasion. Moreover, the USB plug ensures that powering the LED lights is a breeze, eliminating the need for traditional power adapters and adding convenience. Features /Function /Design: Designed with a modern twist, the tree features dynamic lighting patterns that bring a sophisticated charm to your holiday decor. Its sleek lines and clean facade promote a contemporary vibe, making it an ideal companion for modern homes looking to elevate their Christmas aesthetics. Recommended Uses: Perfect for indoor and sheltered outdoor environments, this Christmas tree is versatile enough to complement living rooms, gardens, and terraces. Whether it's a grand party or an intimate family gathering, its charm adapts beautifully to various settings and occasions. Care &Maintenance: To ensure longevity, assemble following the manufacturer's instructions. Always ensure the LED light string is properly connected and stored after the season ends to preserve its efficacy and vitality for the upcoming year. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 110 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 1210 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Black Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

vsmpb2m0.baseName: Charles Bentley 55cm Artificial Christmas Wreath - Green
vsmpb2m0.variantName: Charles Bentley 55cm Artificial Christmas Wreath - Green
vsmpb2m0.sourceDescription: Our 55cm Wreath with Red Bow & Berries is Christmas in its most familiar form – deep green foliage, red berry clusters, and a generous red bow. It's a classic look you'll come back to year after year. Hang it on the front door as the first thing guests see, or bring it indoors for a hallway, a feature wall, or above the fireplace. The rich green foliage is dressed with vivid red berry clusters and a full, bold red bow – delivering a warm, traditional Christmas look. At 55cm wide, it's a generous size that fills a door panel or wall space with ease. Lightweight, easy to hang, and ready straight from the box. Ideal for: Front doors, interior doors, walls, narrow hallways, window frames. Please Note: Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Features: • Traditional red and green – the most recognisable Christmas pairing and an easy base to build a wider colour scheme • Bold red bow and vivid red berry clusters create a warm traditional Christmas display with real visual depth • Dense green foliage base with layered detailing that looks considered and fully decorated • Durable plastic construction – colour-fast no needle drop no mess • Lightweight and easy to hang – no tools or assembly required • Compact to store flat between seasons Includes: • 1x Christmas Wreath with Red Bow & Berries Materials: • Plastic (foliage and berries) • Fabric (bow) Dimensions: • Diameter: 55cm • D3.5, H55, W55cm Weights: • 1.8kg Colours: • Green with red bow and red berry accents Additional Info: • Styling: Hang flush against a front door interior wall or window frame. Pairs well with matching full wreaths or garlands for a coordinated hallway display. • Construction: Durable plastic foliage and berry detailing with fabric bow – holds its shape and colour reliably across multiple festive seasons. • Storage: Store flat in a cool dry place between seasons. Reshape branches lightly each year for best results. • Care: Wipe foliage with a dry or lightly damp cloth to remove dust. Dimensions: H55, W55, D3.5cm Warning: decorative item, not a toy. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and ignition sources. Hang securely so it cannot fall. Keep small decorative parts, ribbons and artificial berries away from young children and pets to reduce choking or entanglement risk. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

kyvy7pq1.sourceDescription: Give your door a spooky stare this season with the 40cm Halloween Bauble Wreath – Eyeball Edition. Bursting with Halloween personality, this wreath features a bold mix of glossy, glitter, and metallic baubles in orange, black, and gold, plus unique details like giant 3D eyeballs, glitter spiders, textured pumpkins, and striped spiderweb baubles for a creepy-cool finish. With its fun and fearsome look, this wreath is perfect for Halloween decorating—but it also makes a standout piece for spooky-themed Christmas displays, gothic décor lovers, or anyone who enjoys a twist on tradition. Compact yet packed with detail, the Eyeball Wreath is ideal for front doors, walls, or windows—and guaranteed to catch the eye of every guest or trick-or-treater. Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

Made to complement realistic Christmas trees and white Xmas trees, these wooden Christmas tree skirts provide the perfect foundation for any festive scene. Match with any of our full-width trees between 6ft-8ft in height. Coming in four parts, they’re super easy to assemble; just unfold, place under the tree, and clip together. Simple!
